plain_text:
Herbert Marshall appears in 90 recordings across 8 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1936 to 1958. The credits here include performer and host.

In this archive, you will hear Herbert Marshall most often in A Man Called X, Lux Radio Theatre, Old Gold Comedy Theater, Suspense, Matinee Theater, CBS Radio Workshop, Lum and Abner, and NBC University Theater.

Characters credited here include Ken Thurston.
